Method — every Qloo call

    01 · Find
    Your place in the taste graph

    Your business — or a couple of look-alikes — becomes a point among Qloo's 250M+ entities.

    02 · Subtract
    Remove what everyone likes

    For music, film, brands and books, each match is checked against your city's general top 200. Anything already popular there is crossed out.

    03 · Act
    A month of marketing

    An agent writes events, a playlist, collaborations, ad targeting and three posts — citing Qloo's numbers, inventing nothing.
